companies.AiSee: NUS Enterprise@SSP-resident Singapore deep-tech startup (NUS School of Computing spin-out, 2025) building AiSee — a self-contained AI-powered wearable visual companion for the visually impaired with bone-conduction audio, on-device Meta Llama models, and capabilities like label-reading and text translation. Won the 2024 Meta Llama Impact Innovation Award; pre-orders at S$199. Drop generic 'AI see' / vision-AI hype unless it names this device.
